content.title: About
content.content: The Gimlet is a classic cocktail made of gin (or vodka) and fresh lime juice sweetened with simple syrup. It has a refreshing, slightly tart‑sweet flavor and is usually served in a chilled glass.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The first Gimlet recipe appeared in the early 1920s.
The name comes from a popular gin brand of the time called "Gimlet".
The original recipe used only gin, but in the United States it is often made with vodka.
The Gimlet is commonly regarded as a "summer evening" drink because of its light citrus note.
The cocktail gained renewed fame in the 1970s thanks to the film "Casino".

items.title: Vitamin C
items.content: Lime juice is rich in vitamin C, which supports the immune system.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Phytochemicals in lime provide antioxidant properties.

items.title: Moderate alcohol intake
items.content: When consumed in moderation, alcohol can promote relaxation and improve mood.

items.title: Alcohol
items.content: Excessive alcohol consumption can lead to health problems, including dependence.

items.title: Lime acidity
items.content: High acidity may irritate the stomach lining in people with gastritis.

items.title: Citrus allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience an allergic reaction to lime juice.

content.title: How to Drink
content.content: Serve the Gimlet in a chilled coupe glass without ice. Combine 2 oz gin (or vodka), 1 oz fresh lime juice, and ½ oz simple syrup, shake with ice, then strain.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store alcoholic spirits in a cool, dark place. Fresh lime juice is best used immediately, but can be kept in the refrigerator for up to 2 days.
